prompt:
Rebuild the following powder diffractometer in McStas from its specification, run it, and report the integrated intensity (with error and event count) on every monitor.

Instrument parameters (defaults in parentheses):
- lambda (2.36)
- DM (3.355)
- Mono_tilt (0)
- powder ("Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz")
- det_rotation (45)

Constants and derived quantities computed at startup (implement equivalent logic):
```c
printf("RTP_DIF: Monochromator take-off angle=%g [deg]\n",
    2*asin(lambda/2/DM)*RAD2DEG);
```

Beamline, in order (positions in meters; AT [x,y,z] RELATIVE to the named component; parameters as given):
- Origin: Progress_bar AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
- source: Source_gen AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: radius=.154/2, dist=1.16+1.50, focus_xw=.11, focus_yh=.03, lambda0=lambda, dlambda=.2, I1=2.79e12/4/PI, T1=300
- CoarseCollimator1: Guide AT [0, 0, .01] RELATIVE source ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: w1=.154, h1=.154, l=1.16125, m=0
- CoarseCollimator2: Guide AT [0, 0, 1.16125+0.003] RELATIVE CoarseCollimator1 ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: w1=.11, h1=.11, l=1.5, m=0
- lmon: Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 1.5+0.01] RELATIVE CoarseCollimator2 ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: xwidth=.11, bins=50, options="slit disk, auto wavelength"
- Be_Position: Arm AT [0, 0, .147+.15/2] RELATIVE lmon ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
- mono_cradle: Arm AT [0, 0, .145+.15/2+.176] RELATIVE Be_Position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE  (SPLIT 10)
- mono_rotation: Arm AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, -asin(lambda/2/DM)*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle
    EXTEND: ```c
    mono_index=0;
    ```
- mono1: Monochromator_curved AT [-.01, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation ROTATED [0, Mono_tilt, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation
    parameters: reflect="HOPG.rfl", transmit="HOPG.trm", NH=1, NV=1, mosaich=48, mosaicv=48, RV=0, RH=0, DM=DM, width=.11, height=.03
    EXTEND: ```c
    if (SCATTERED) mono_index=1;
    ```
- mono2: Monochromator_curved AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation
    parameters: reflect="HOPG.rfl", transmit="HOPG.trm", NH=1, NV=1, mosaich=48, mosaicv=48, RV=0, RH=0, DM=DM, width=.11, height=.03
    EXTEND: ```c
    if (SCATTERED) mono_index=2;
    ```
- mono3: Monochromator_curved AT [0.01, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation ROTATED [0, -Mono_tilt, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation
    parameters: reflect="HOPG.rfl", transmit="HOPG.trm", NH=1, NV=1, mosaich=48, mosaicv=48, RV=0, RH=0, DM=DM, width=.11, height=.03
    EXTEND: ```c
    if (SCATTERED) mono_index=3;
    ```
- mono_takeoff: Arm AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, -2*asin(lambda/2/DM)*RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle
- psd_transmit: Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0.25] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE  (GROUP mono_rt)
    parameters: xwidth=.12, yheight=.12, bins=50, options="x y"
- psd_reflect: Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0.574] RELATIVE mono_takeoff ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE  (GROUP mono_rt)
    parameters: xwidth=.12, yheight=.12, bins=50, options="x y"
- sample_psd: Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0.575+.50] RELATIVE mono_takeoff ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: xwidth=.02, yheight=.02, bins=50, options="disk slit, x y"
- sample_position: Arm AT [0, 0, .575+.5+.01] RELATIVE mono_takeoff ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE  (SPLIT 100)
- container_in: PowderN AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: reflections="V.lau", radius=0.01/2, yheight=0.04, thickness=-50e-6, p_transmit=.95, d_phi=50, concentric=1
- sample: PowderN AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: reflections=powder, radius=0.01/2, yheight=0.04, d_phi=atan2(0.5,1)*RAD2DEG
    EXTEND: ```c
    if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB;
    ```
- container_out: PowderN AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: reflections="V.lau", radius=0.01/2, yheight=0.04, thickness=-50e-6, p_transmit=.95, d_phi=50, concentric=1
- sample_out: Arm AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, det_rotation, 0] RELATIVE sample_position
- det_big: Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: yheight=.5, radius=1, options="banana theta limits=[-150 150] bins=300, y bins=64"
- det: Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 1] RELATIVE sample_out ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: xwidth=.5, yheight=.0254, bins=25, options="x"
- reactor: Shape AT [0, 0, -.35] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    parameters: radius=.7/2, yheight=.4

Your instrument must include at least: a 2D position-sensitive monitor; a wavelength monitor.
Run with: lambda=2.36, DM=3.355, Mono_tilt=0, powder=Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz, det_rotation=45.
